# Tamboti Tenders

Tamboti Tenders tracks public procurement tenders across Africa, pulled
directly from government portals, development agencies, and official
gazettes, then normalized so they can be searched and filtered in one
place. Browsing and searching is free with no account required; a free
account adds bookmarks and deadline alerts, and Pro removes the visibility
delay on tenders closing further out.

## Pages

- [Browse tenders](https://www.tambotitender.com/tenders): searchable, filterable list of live procurement tenders by country, category, and deadline.
- [Blog](https://www.tambotitender.com/blog): procurement market trends and tender insights across Africa.
- [Pricing](https://www.tambotitender.com/pricing): Free and Pro plan details.
- [Sitemap](https://www.tambotitender.com/sitemap.xml): full list of indexable pages, including individual tender and blog post URLs.
